_doc: ROUTES-1108: per-host PORTAL verdicts for vera/reference_portal.py (seed; a DB table is the later target under the no-hardcoded-data rule, its DDL is owner-gated). DEFAULT DENY: a host with no row, or a row whose status is not active or whose terms is not permit, is never fetched as a portal (counted host_unchecked: the terms-reading queue). A row is matched by exact host. paths_allow is a full-match regex on the URL path (no query string is ever allowed); rate_portal must name a config/rate_limits.json portal that lists this host, else the row is invalid (no request). Robots.txt, Content-Signal and TDM signals are read at run time and can only narrow a row, never widen it. Terms verdicts are summarizer-level reads (WebFetch), dated, with review_by; a reviewer checks the evidence path before a row becomes active.
